parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AI template. You can obtain the template ID by using one of the following methods:
- When you call the [AddAITemplate](~~102930~~) operation to add an AI template, the template ID is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.
- After the AI template is added, call the [ListAITemplate](~~102936~~) operation to query the template ID, which is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.
